items.name: BlenderBEM
items.description: This is a Blender addon to solve boundary element method equations using Python.

items.name: PY2D_BEM
items.description: Python Library for solve Laplace Poisson Equation via Boundary Element Method

items.name: FEM_Heating_Transfer
items.description: This project implements the Finite Element Method (FEM) in Python to solve heat conduction equations with Robin and Dirichlet boundary conditions, using Gaussian quadrature for numerical integration.

items.name: Finite-Element-Method-Toolbox
items.description: A Python finite-element toolbox with a Tkinter GUI, CG/DG methods, P1/P2 bases, custom PDEs and domains, dynamic mixed boundary conditions, transient theta-method solvers, hp refinement diagnostics, convergence analysis, visualization, and CSV export.

items.name: FEM_Applied_1_D_PDE_Solver_Using_Python-
items.description: This project implements the Finite Element Method (FEM) in Python to solve a 1-D PDE with mixed Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions.   We derive the weak form of the PDE, define Lagrange basis functions, assemble the global stiffness matrix and force vector, apply boundary conditions, and compare results to the analytical solution.

items.name: 1D-elliptic-finite-element-method-code-for-DRP-project
items.description: Python code for finite element solvers for the 2-point boundary value problem u(a)=u(b) = 0 of the 1D elliptic equation -u'' = f.  The "loop" files iterate over multiple values for n and calculate the convergence rate for L2 and H1 norms at the end. "fconst" files simplify for when f is a constant function.

items.name: BEM2D-Elastostatics-ELQUABE
items.description: Modernized Fortran 90 implementation of Brebbia & Dominguez's ELQUABE code for 2D elastostatic Boundary Element Method (BEM) with quadratic elements, featuring OpenMP parallelization, LAPACK (DGESV) solver, boundary/von Mises stress recovery, and Python/Gmsh pre- and post-processing.

items.name: BEM3D-Elastoplastic
items.description: Parallel Fortran 90 / OpenMP / LAPACK 3D Linear-Elastic and Elastoplastic Boundary Element Method (BEM) solver using 6-node quadratic triangles (triangle6) and 10-node tetrahedral cells (tetra10), with Gmsh/Python pre- and post-processing.
